description: This file defines a PHP class 'SessionSubscriber' that subscribes to Symfony's KernelRequest events. It manages user sessions by invalidating sessions when they exceed a configured idle timeout. The class uses Symfony components and project-specific services to perform its logic.

classes.name: SessionSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber that hooks into Symfony's kernel request event to manage user sessions, invalidating them if they have been idle beyond a configured timeout.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the Kernel's REQUEST event with a high priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the Kernel request event by checking session last used time and invalidating the session if it exceeds the maximum idle time configured.
